items.q: Do 'precise' and 'accurate' mean the same thing?
items.correct: No — precise means repeatable; accurate means close to the true value.
items.random_wrong: Repeating a reading removes systematic error.
items.why: You can be precise but inaccurate; repeats reduce random error, not systematic error.

items.q: What should you do with a clear anomalous result?
items.correct: Identify it and usually leave it out of the mean.
items.misconception: Always include it in the mean.
items.random_wrong: Take just one reading to save time.
items.why: Anomalies are normally excluded; repeats and a mean improve reliability.
